name: drake.equation
description: Interactive Drake Equation calculator — estimate the number of communicative extraterrestrial civilizations in the Milky Way.

scripts.build: if not exist dist mkdir dist && copy index.html dist && copy styles.css dist && xcopy /E /I /Y css dist\css && xcopy /E /I /Y js dist\js && xcopy /E /I /Y assets dist\assets
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:css

author: Mikel Aramendia
